rows.method: 2026E forward P/E base business plus risk-adjusted Physical AI real option
rows.secondary_method: segment revenue/margin bridge, public EPS comparison and FY2028 option scenario present value
rows.physical_ai_option_horizon: FY2028 outcomes discounted two years at 12%
rows.physical_ai_option_probability_basis: AStock house underwriting; 55% no conversion, 35% first commercial scale, 10% replicable platform scale
rows.catalyst: reacceleration in reported revenue, stable intelligent-driving margin and cash conversion; Physical AI G1 named commercial identity, G2 delivery/revenue, G3 unit economics
rows.invalidation: delivery slowdown, margin decline, working-capital deterioration; no Physical AI delivery/revenue evidence reduces risk-adjusted option probabilities
rows.evidence_quality: high for 2025 reported base and price/share math; conditional for 2026 house forecast; low-confidence AStock probability-weighted Physical AI option; no auditable broker target
